name: Shoujo Yoshitsuneden 2 ~Toki o Koeru Chigiri~
original_name: 少女義経伝・弐 〜刻を超える契り〜
source:
After ending the Genpei War and sealing away the Aion, Benkei settled into life in the modern day. But out of nowhere, he found himself thrown back to the late Heian period.
Benkei and Yoshitsune had a dramatic reunion, but he had lost his memory from the shock of the time slip.
From western Japan all the way to Oshu, the curtain will rise on the Heian Sengoku epic once more.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050512013412fw_/http://www.wellmade.jp/products/yoshitsune2/index.html]the official website[/url]]
translation:
源平战争结束并封锁了永恒之塔后，弁庆开始了现代生活。但不知为何，他发现自己回到了平安时代后期。
弁庆和义经戏剧性地重逢，但义经却因时间流逝的震惊而失去了记忆。
从日本西部一直到奥州，平安战国史诗将再次拉开帷幕。

[翻译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050512013412fw_/http://www.wellmade.jp/products/yoshitsune2/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
